I'm sorry to hear your package hasn't arrived even though the tracking says it's delivered. Don't worry, this happens occasionally, and we can help figure it out. 🔍

Here are a few steps you can take to locate it:

Check your surroundings: Look around your property, including porches, side doors, or garages. If you're in an apartment, check the mailroom, lobby, or with the front desk.
Ask your neighbors: The package may have been delivered to a nearby address by mistake.
Wait a little longer: Sometimes, packages are marked as delivered a few hours before they actually arrive. It will often show up within 24 hours.

If you've tried these steps and still can't find your package, please reach out to us within 30 days of the last tracking update. We will work with FedEx to trace the package, which usually takes 48-72 hours. If it can't be located, we'll make it right with a replacement or a refund.
